## Authorship

All content on this site is written by me. No articles, posts, or essays are generated or ghost-written by AI language models. I do use AI tools for research assistance, as part of the project discussed by a post, and spelling and grammar checking.

## License

Unless noted otherwise, the writing and original images on this site are licensed under [Creative Commons Attribution 4.0 (CC BY 4.0)](https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by/4.0/): you may share and adapt them, including commercially, as long as you credit me.

## Images

Images fall into one of the following categories:

- **Original work** — created by me. Free to use with attribution.
- **Unsplash** — sourced from [Unsplash](https://unsplash.com) under the [Unsplash License](https://unsplash.com/license). Free to use without attribution, though I will credit the photographer where possible.
- **Public domain** — images explicitly in the public domain or released under CC0.
- **Creative Commons** — used under the license its creator chose (for example CC BY 4.0), with the credit that license requires.
- **Book covers and similar material** — copyrighted by their publishers and shown in reviews under fair use. They are not covered by this site's license.

Where an image has a specific license or attribution requirement, it is noted on the page where it appears.

If you believe an image has been used incorrectly, please open a GitHub Discussion or email [blog@lux-ferrata.org](mailto:blog@lux-ferrata.org).

## Comments

Comments are powered by [Giscus](https://giscus.app), which uses GitHub Discussions. A GitHub account is required to comment.

I ask that discussions remain constructive and in good faith. I reserve the right to remove comments that are abusive, spam, or off-topic.

## Privacy

Page views are counted with [GoatCounter](https://www.goatcounter.com), which sets no cookies and doesn't track individual visitors. Comments load [Giscus](https://giscus.app) from GitHub, but only on post pages; GitHub's privacy policy applies there.

## Corrections

If you spot a factual error, please open a GitHub Discussion or email [blog@lux-ferrata.org](mailto:blog@lux-ferrata.org). I will correct errors and note the correction in the affected post.
